infobox.usage: Unlocks the living room in apartment 63 on the second floor of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia apartment 63 room key (Conc 63) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms in apartment 63 in the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Living room door in apartment 63 on the second floor of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (Valuables, Electronics, Medical items, Stimulants)
